text: Families often decide to join after the visit, once they've seen the bill. If they join within twenty-four business hours, Scout re-prices that visit as if they'd been members, and refunds the difference.
Remember: sign them up within twenty-four business hours of the visit, and Scout does the refund for you.
Juniper's visit this morning is paid. The badge shows how many business hours are left.
Click Post-appointment sign-up.
Tick the paid visit you want re-priced.
Plans are filtered to Juniper's species and age. Scout marks the one it recommends.
Choose Feline Foundations, monthly.
Click Calculate refund.
What Maria paid, what the plan covers, the monthly charge, and the one-time refund.
Read this line to Maria. It's exactly what she'll see on her card.
Covered lines are listed first. The flea and tick dose isn't covered, so she still pays for it.
If Maria isn't with you, choose Email the agreement to sign.
She gets a link that lasts twenty-four hours. Nothing is charged or refunded until she signs, and you get a task if she doesn't.
Maria is here, so switch back to Owner is here.
Maria has a card on file, so it pays the membership: fifty-nine dollars today, then every month.
She ticks the agreement,
signs,
and types her name.
The button says exactly what will happen. Click it.
Done. The receipt shows the refund back to Maria's card, the first month's charge, and that she's been emailed the breakdown.
Click Done. Juniper is now a member.
The most common mistakes: waiting past the window, and refunding by hand on top of this. Remember: sign them up within twenty-four business hours of the visit, and Scout does the refund for you.
